description: Find step-by-step fixes for MCP errors. Paste the error message (or describe the problem) and optionally filter by client. Returns matching fixes; use get_fix for the full steps.

client.description: Only fixes for this client, e.g. 'Cursor', 'Claude Desktop'

error.description: Error text or a description, e.g. 'spawn npx ENOENT' or 'server not showing in Cursor'. Omit to list all fixes.

name: search_fixes
title: Search MCP error fixes
